## Instruction A（全文）

Task: Detect land cover change using BULC-D
Detect land cover changes by analyzing time series of satellite imagery using the Bayesian Updating of Land Cover (BULC-D) method, comparing expectation and target periods across multiple sensors to compute probabilities of change, no change, increase, or decrease in spectral indices like NBR.

## Instruction B（全文）

Task: Detect land cover change using BULC-D
Detect land cover changes by analyzing time series of satellite imagery using the BULC-D (Bayesian Updating of Land Cover Determination) algorithm, comparing expectation and target periods to compute probabilities of change, no change, and direction of change (increase or decrease) in spectral indices like NBR.

    function runBULCD() {

        D = func.updateParams(D, "expectationCollectionParameters", expectationCollectionParameters);

        D = func.updateParams(D, "targetCollectionParameters", targetCollectionParameters);

        if(verbose){

          print('XXXXXXXXX 123456 Whole dictionary', D)

          }

        bulcD_input = afn_organizeBULCD_Inputs(D);

        var var_args_BULCD = {}

        var_args_BULCD.defaultStudyArea = D.defaultStudyArea

        var_args_BULCD.binCuts = D.binCuts

        var_args_BULCD.targetLOFAsZScore = bulcD_input.targetLOFAsZScore

        var BULCargumentDictionaryPlus = getBULCParameterDictionary() // pulls the BULC-specific parameter set from another file.

        var_args_BULCD.BULCargumentDictionaryPlus = BULCargumentDictionaryPlus

        print("Arguments to BULC-D", var_args_BULCD)

        fullBULCReturn = afn_BULCD(var_args_BULCD);

        print('fullBULCReturn', fullBULCReturn);

        mapGrid.clear();

        mapGrid.add(getLinkedMaps(maps, bulcD_input, fullBULCReturn, D));

        {

            var gena = require('users/gena/packages:palettes');

            BULCargumentDictionary = BULCargumentDictionaryPlus.BULCargumentDictionary

    function runBULCD() {

        D = func.updateParams(D, "allSensorDictionary", allSensorDictionary);

        D = func.updateParams(D, "expectationCollectionParameters", expectationCollectionParameters);

        D = func.updateParams(D, "targetCollectionParameters", targetCollectionParameters);

        print('Whole dictionary', D)

        bulcD_input = afn_organizeBULCD_Inputs(D);

        var var_args_BULCD = {}

        var_args_BULCD.defaultStudyArea = D.defaultStudyArea

        var_args_BULCD.binCuts = D.binCuts

        var_args_BULCD.targetLOFAsZScore = bulcD_input.targetLOFAsZScore

        var BULCargumentDictionaryPlus = getBULCParameterDictionary() // pulls the BULC-specific parameter set from another file.

        var_args_BULCD.BULCargumentDictionaryPlus = BULCargumentDictionaryPlus

        print("Arguments to BULC-D", var_args_BULCD)

        fullBULCReturn = afn_BULCD(var_args_BULCD);

        print('fullBULCReturn', fullBULCReturn);

        mapGrid.clear();

        mapGrid.add(getLinkedMaps(maps, bulcD_input, fullBULCReturn, D));

        {

            var gena = require('users/gena/packages:palettes');

            BULCargumentDictionary = BULCargumentDictionaryPlus.BULCargumentDictionary

            COLLECTION = ee.ImageCollection(cc.afn_convertMultibandToCollectionSimpleV4(ee.Image(fullBULCReturn.allEventLayers)));

            COLLECTION = helperFunctionsModule.styleImg('ic', COLLECTION, 3, gena.crameri.oslo[10]);

            BULC_COLLECTION = ee.ImageCollection(cc.afn_convertMultibandToCollectionSimpleV4(ee.Image(fullBULCReturn.allBULCLayers.byte())));

            BULC_COLLECTION = helperFunctionsModule.styleImg('ic', BULC_COLLECTION, 3, ['red', 'green', 'blue']);

            CONFIDENCE = ee.ImageCollection(cc.afn_convertMultibandToCollectionSimpleV4(ee.Image(fullBULCReturn.allConfidenceLayers)));

        }

        thirdSubPanel.clear();

        thirdPanel.clear();

        thirdPanel.add(showModes());

        thirdPanel.add(thirdSubPanel);

    }

    var splitPanelRight = ui.SplitPanel({

        firstPanel: mapGrid,

        secondPanel: thirdPanel,

        wipe: false,

    });

    ui.root.widgets().reset([firstPanel, splitPanelRight]);

}

runBULCD_Interface();
